vedic_reference.note: Suraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sūrya' which refers to the Sun God. In Hindu mythology, Sūrya is considered as one of the primary deities, and is often depicted riding a chariot pulled by seven horses and holding a lotus flower. He is also known as 'Ravi' and 'Aditya', and is believed to bring life and energy to the earth.
